templates.pattern: In a class of [N] students, [P1] ranks [A]th from top. [P2] ranks [B]th from bottom. How many students are between [P1] and [P2]?

Train A departs at [AH]:[AM] and travels at [AS] km/h. Train B departs at [BH]:[BM] from the same station and travels at [BS] km/h in the same direction. After how many hours does Train B overtake Train A?
templates.explanation: Head start = AS*(BH-AH). Overtake time (after B departs) = Head start / (BS-AS) = [AS]*([BH]-[AH])/([BS]-[AS])

templates.pattern: In a race, [P1] finishes [A] seconds before [P2]. [P2] finishes [B] seconds before [P3]. [P3]'s time is [T3] seconds. What is [P1]'s time?
A project started on [DATE] of [MONTH]. It takes [WEEKS] weeks to complete. On what date does it end? (Assume 4 weeks = 28 days)
A clock gains [G] minutes every [H] hours. It shows correct time at [SH]:[SM]. After [D] hours, what time does the clock show?
templates.explanation: Clock gains G*D extra minutes over D hours. Shown time = Actual time + G*D = [SH]:[SM] + [D]hrs + [D]*[G]min

templates.pattern: [P1] starts a journey at [SH]:[SM] and travels at [SP] km/h. [P2] starts [K] hours later from the same point at [SP2] km/h in the same direction. At what time does [P2] catch [P1]?
templates.explanation: Time for [P2] to catch = SP*K/(SP2-SP). [P2] catches at time = SH+K + SP*K/(SP2-SP)

templates.pattern: Five persons [P1]-[P5] appeared for an interview on consecutive days. [P3] appeared on Wednesday. [P1] appeared [K] days before [P3]. [P5] appeared 2 days after [P3]. [P2] appeared just before [P5]. What day did [P4] appear?
A series of tasks must be completed in order. Task 1 takes [T1] mins, Task 2 takes [T2] mins, Task 3 takes [T3] mins, Task 4 takes [T4] mins. Starting at [SH]:[SM], when is Task 3 completed?
templates.explanation: Task 3 completes at Start + T1 + T2 + T3 = [SH]:[SM] + [T1]+[T2]+[T3] mins

templates.pattern: Event A ends at [AH]:[AM]. Event B starts [GAP] minutes after Event A ends and lasts [BD] minutes. Event C starts immediately after Event B. At what time does Event C start?
templates.explanation: Event C starts at AH:AM + GAP + BD = [AH]:[AM] + [GAP] + [BD] minutes

templates.pattern: [P1] finishes a job in [D1] days. [P2] finishes the same job in [D2] days. They work together for [W] days. What fraction of the job is left?
templates.explanation: Work per day together = 1/D1+1/D2. Done in W days = W*(1/D1+1/D2). Left = 1 - W*(1/[D1]+1/[D2])

templates.pattern: A clock is [FAST] minutes fast. It shows [SH]:[SM]. What is the correct time?
templates.explanation: Correct time = Shown time - Fast minutes = [SH]:[SM] - [FAST] mins

templates.pattern: In a class of [N] students, [P1] is [A]th from top. [K] students join the class, all ranked above [P1]. [M] students ranked above [P1] leave. What is [P1]'s new rank?
templates.explanation: New rank = A + Joined above - Left above = [A]+[K]-[M]
